# Claude Code response-only 2.1.321 and 2.1.322 evidence stop

This corpus records official npm latest and GitHub stable `2.1.322`, complete wrapper, Darwin arm64, and Linux x64 package inventories for the published `2.1.321` and `2.1.322` hops, exact tarball integrity, extracted file hashes, and static marker counts. The earlier `2.1.319` files and evidence are retained by reference.

`2.1.320` was not published to npm and has no GitHub tag, so it remains an excluded gap. `2.1.323` is the first unpublished point above official latest. The qualified response-only ceiling remains `2.1.319`; `2.1.321` and `2.1.322` remain `UnverifiedNewer`.

The wrapper launch shim, `cli-wrapper.cjs`, and `install.cjs` are unchanged from `2.1.319`; the SDK declaration change is unrelated. Both native executables change at each hop. Marker counts and matching help strings do not establish selected native behavior or path reachability, and release notes do not settle the stream-json NFS failure, hooks/settings, or shutdown paths. The static evidence is therefore insufficient to qualify either hop on either platform. No downloaded executable was run, and no provider prompt, login, installation, or live session was used.

Response-only keeps its independent `stream-json.v3` claim through `2.1.319`. Headless remains at `2.1.317`; this task does not change its claim or implement its separate adaptation lead.
